latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — instantly create and export short videos for TikTok, Reels, and more with an AI-powered workflow.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe the short you want.
- AI automatically cuts, captions, and prepares short videos (recommended: 9:16 vertical format).
- Export finished shorts in high-quality 1080p MP4, ready to download within 30–90 seconds.
- Free plan includes 100 credits (no account needed); supports proxy authentication and session management.
- Clear user instructions, automatic error handling, and live status updates built in.
